records.title: Number And Proportion Of Inter-Ethnic And Transnational Marriages Among Citizen Marriages, Annual
records.footnote: Total may include marriages with attribute(s) not reported. Citizen marriages refer to marriages involving at least one citizen.

row.footnote: Inter-ethnic marriages refer to marriages between persons of different ethnic groups, namely Chinese, Malay, Indian and Others.
Transnational marriages refer to marriages involving one citizen and one non-citizen (i.e. permanent resident or non-resident).
